long_biography.plain_text:
R+S began with Bergmann's grandfather and developed into a specialist in paper rolls. Bergmann joined the business in 2002 and later became its managing director. After the company moved into Hansol ownership, he continued with the combined Schades and R+S operation as a senior commercial and executive leader.

Bergmann founded Harbour Investment as a dedicated long-term investor in the paper industry. In 2020, the new vehicle acquired Schades and R+S, bringing the businesses back under German family control. He now chairs Harbour and Schades, overseeing a European portfolio that produces point-of-sale rolls, self-adhesive labels, linerless products and flexible packaging. He also serves as president of the European Converted Paper Association.
